categories.main_business_segments: Fujian Green Pine Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the cosmetics industry, focusing on the design, research, and manufacturing of face masks, skincare products, wet wipes, and non-woven fabric products. Its main business is conducted through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Nosbell, which is one of the largest domestic ODM cosmetics manufacturers in China. The company offers a comprehensive product portfolio including face masks, skincare series, wet wipes, and other related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies such as microemulsion, liquid-oil instant emulsification, freeze-drying chip technology, electrospinning technology, and BFS blow-fill-seal production lines. It has a strong R&D team with over 180 professionals and holds 124 patents, including 61 invention patents. The production process integrates design, formulation, packaging, and quality control, supported by certifications like ISO9001, ISO13485, cGMP, ISO22716, and Halal certification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers include international and domestic well-known cosmetics brands, channel brands, social e-commerce brands, and emerging e-commerce brands. Notable clients include Unilever, Procter & Gamble, Estée Lauder, Sephora, Watsons, Shiseido, Nivea, Dettol, GAMA, and domestic brands like Shanghai Jahwa, Perfect Diary, Herborist, and Miniso. The products serve both domestic and international markets, with exports accounting for about 18.41% of revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: Fujian Green Pine operates primarily in China with significant sales in regions such as East China, South China, North China, and exports to overseas markets including Europe. The company has production bases and subsidiaries located in Guangdong, Zhejiang, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and South Korea, supporting its domestic and international operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream of the cosmetics supply chain as an ODM manufacturer, providing integrated design, R&D, and manufacturing services for cosmetics brands. It sources raw materials such as chemical ingredients, non-woven fabrics, and packaging materials from global suppliers and delivers finished products to brand owners and retailers downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology leadership and efficiency, investing heavily in R&D and digital factory upgrades. It focuses on innovation in raw materials, formulations, and production processes, including sustainable development and advanced materials like bioactive nanofibers. Strategic partnerships with universities and research institutes support continuous innovation, with ongoing projects in plant-based active ingredients, electrospinning membranes, micro-nano encapsulation, and skin efficacy evaluation technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of ODM cosmetic products to brand customers based on confirmed orders. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, designing and producing products under clients' brands. Revenue is recognized at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance, including domestic sales and exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Fujian Green Pine, through its subsidiary Nosbell, is positioned as one of the largest domestic ODM cosmetics manufacturers in China, competing with both domestic and international ODM/OEM enterprises. It holds a leading market position supported by strong R&D, quality control, and extensive client relationships with top-tier brands. The company has received numerous industry awards recognizing its innovation and manufacturing excellence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.94 billion, a slight decrease of 1.51% from the previous year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 54.68 million, a significant turnaround from a loss in 2023. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 2.13 billion and equity of RMB 1.3 billion. It has shown improved profitability and cash flow, with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and digital transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself by offering comprehensive ODM services with strong R&D capabilities, advanced manufacturing technologies, and strict quality control systems. It provides innovative, high-quality, and customized cosmetic products that meet diverse consumer needs, supported by a broad patent portfolio and sustainable development initiatives. Its ability to rapidly respond to market trends and customer demands, combined with a stable supply chain and extensive client base, underpins its competitive advantage.
